items.source: Returns a sequential Stream for the names managed by this source.
items.translation: 返回一个按顺序的 Stream，用于此源管理的 names。

items.source: Return an iterator for the names managed by this source.
items.translation: 返回由该源管理的names的迭代器。

items.source: Return a filtered variant of this source, containing only names that match the given Predicate.
items.translation: 返回此源的过滤变体，其中仅包含匹配给定Predicate的名称。

items.source: Return a variant of this source that supports name aliases.
items.translation: 返回一个支持名称别名的此源变体。

items.source: Return a variant of this source that supports a prefix.
items.translation: 返回一个支持前缀的此源变体。

items.source: A ConfigurationPropertySource with a fully Iterable set of entries. Implementations of this interface must be able to iterate over all contained configuration properties. Any non-null result from ConfigurationPropertySource.getConfigurationProperty(ConfigurationPropertyName) must also have an equivalent entry in the iterator.
items.translation: 一个具有完全Iterable条目集的ConfigurationPropertySource。此接口的实现必须能够遍历所有包含的配置属性。从ConfigurationPropertySource.getConfigurationProperty(ConfigurationPropertyName)获得的任何non-null结果也必须在iterator中具有等效条目。

items.source: Returns if the source contains any descendants of the specified name. May return ConfigurationPropertyState.PRESENT or ConfigurationPropertyState.ABSENT if an answer can be determined or ConfigurationPropertyState.UNKNOWN if it's not possible to determine a definitive answer.
